params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: Naming a platform copy of a photo asked the bucket for a directory listing, and when that listing failed the request threw `UnableToCheckDirectoryExistence` (Nightwatch #79). Rule R S1-6.38 forbids that call on the vehicles disk, but its guard test did not see this one.

Source: Portal mail:66, the Nightwatch notice for issue #79 (production, 2026-11-24 14:56:41, once).

## What happened

`League\Flysystem\UnableToCheckDirectoryExistence: Unable to check existence for: 24182/stocklist_car_image_7.jpg`, unhandled, at `app/Support/PhotoNames.php:24`.

`PhotoNames::free` picks a free name for a platform copy (`stocklist_car_image_7.jpg`, then `(1)`, `(2)`, ...) with `Storage::disk($disk)->exists()`. On Flysystem `exists()` is `has()`: `fileExists() || directoryExists()`. On S3 the second half is a `ListObjectsV2` over the prefix. Here the HEAD answered (no such file yet), and the listing that followed failed. A directory with a photo's name is never what we mean.

R S1-6.38 says exactly this: on the vehicles disk we ask with `fileExists`, never with `exists`. `TheBucketIsNotAskedForADirectoryTest` guards it, but it only looks for the literal `disk('vehicles')->exists(`, and `PhotoNames::free` passes the disk as a variable (`disk($disk)`), so it slipped through.

There are two callers, and both stop on that exception:
- `Photo::createStockListPhotoFromPhoto`, from `VehicleApiService::addPhoto` for a partner's photo. There a throw rolls the whole new vehicle back (as in #1097). Every other bucket question on that path already waits out a throttle (`StorageUnavailable::retryPastThrottle`). The name check is the only one that does not.
- `PlatformPhotoService::duplicate`, when a dealer saves a shared vehicle or turns Stocklist on from the list. A throw there fails the save.

Which caller it was is not in the notice. The production read tools were not admitted for this project when this was written.

## What to do

- `PhotoNames::free` asks `fileExists`, through `StorageUnavailable::retryPastThrottle` like the rest of the partner path.
- The guard test also catches `disk($variable)->exists(` and `->missing(`, so the rule covers a disk name passed in.
- R S1-6.38 names this fourth case.
params.title: Naming a platform photo copy asks the bucket for a directory (Nightwatch #79)
